issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Implement Soroban XDR event topic decoder and missed-event catch-up worker
issues.body:
`lib/soroban/events.ts` listens for on-chain contract events but lacks XDR topic decoding for complex Soroban event structures and does not handle historical event catch-up after web socket reconnects.

## Why this matters
Decoded contract events provide vital real-time status during minting, staking, and governance actions. Missed events during network disconnects lead to out-of-sync UI state.

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement XDR topic decoder in `lib/soroban/events.ts` supporting Soroban ScVal types
- [ ] Add historical event query worker fetching missed events from Soroban RPC `getEvents` endpoint upon reconnection
- [ ] Store processed event sequence numbers in local storage to prevent duplicate event processing
- [ ] Write unit tests for XDR decoding of contract invocation events

## Files to look at
- `lib/soroban/events.ts`
- `lib/soroban/client.ts`
- `features/soroban/`

## Acceptance criteria
- Contract events are automatically decoded into typed JS objects
- Reconnecting clients query missed event windows seamlessly

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Add canonical JSON normalization and cryptographic signature payload encoder
issues.body:
`lib/canonicalization.ts` formats payload strings for signing, but does not enforce deterministic key sorting or whitespace normalization across nested JSON structures.

## Why this matters
Non-canonical JSON serialization results in signature verification failures across different client architectures and browser runtimes.

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) encoder in `lib/canonicalization.ts`
- [ ] Normalize unicode characters, array key ordering, and floating point numbers prior to hashing
- [ ] Add helper function for producing deterministic payload hashes for wallet signing
- [ ] Add unit tests verifying JCS test vectors and cross-platform hash consistency

## Files to look at
- `lib/canonicalization.ts`
- `tests/lib/canonicalization.test.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Identical data structures produce byte-identical canonical JSON representations
- Signature payload hashes match official RFC 8785 reference test vectors

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Build schema versioning migration pipeline and deprecated field warnings
issues.body:
`lib/schema-versioning.ts` handles record versions but lacks step-by-step transform functions (`v1` -> `v2` -> `v3`) and developer warnings for deprecated schema fields.

## Why this matters
As agent metadata and API record schemas evolve, backwards compatibility requires automated migrations for legacy saved data.

## Tasks
- [ ] Define modular migration step registry in `lib/schema-versioning.ts`
- [ ] Add automatic sequential schema upgrader for loaded IndexedDB and LocalStorage records
- [ ] Console warn with deprecation notices when code accesses legacy schema properties
- [ ] Add unit tests verifying multi-version data upgrades (`v1` to `v3` direct and step-wise)

## Files to look at
- `lib/schema-versioning.ts`
- `tests/lib/schema-versioning.test.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Legacy data records are automatically migrated to current schema versions on read
- Accessing deprecated fields outputs informative developer console guidance

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Implement distributed lock manager and idempotency key TTL expiration
issues.body:
`lib/idempotency.ts` prevents duplicate submission requests but lacks automatic TTL cleanup for stale idempotency keys and mutex locks for concurrent tab executions.

## Why this matters
Stale idempotency keys pollute browser storage, while uncoordinated concurrent requests from multiple tabs can trigger duplicate financial transactions.

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement Web Locks API (`navigator.locks`) integration in `lib/idempotency.ts` to synchronize cross-tab executions
- [ ] Add automatic TTL eviction worker purging expired idempotency keys
- [ ] Return standard `409 Conflict` status responses when a concurrent duplicate request is detected
- [ ] Add unit tests simulating cross-tab lock contention

## Files to look at
- `lib/idempotency.ts`
- `lib/tests/idempotency.test.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Concurrent write operations across multiple tabs are safely queued via locks
- Idempotency storage automatically frees space via TTL expiration

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Add automated operational health score calculator and status page endpoint
issues.body:
`lib/operational-health.ts` and `app/api/operational-health/route.ts` report basic health status but lack scoring algorithms for API latency, RPC availability, and error rate metrics.

A unified health score provides maintainers and status monitors with an instant snapshot of application operational degradation.

- [ ] Add sub-system probes for Stellar RPC latency, IPFS gateway status, and WebSocket availability
- [ ] Format `/api/operational-health` response compatible with standard status page services (e.g. Statuspage, Better Stack)
- [ ] Add unit tests verifying health score degradation during simulated RPC latency spikes

## Files to look at
- `lib/operational-health.ts`
- `app/api/operational-health/route.ts`
- `tests/__tests__/operational-health.test.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Health endpoint returns JSON containing component breakdown and overall health score
- Component failures accurately decrease overall operational health percentage

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Implement BroadcastChannel multi-tab session sync and conflict resolution
issues.body:
`features/session-continuity/` provides basic session tracking but does not broadcast state changes (e.g., wallet disconnect, active theme, active agent) across browser tabs in real time.

## Why this matters
When a user logs out or switches wallets in one tab, open tabs can become desynchronized and perform actions under stale credentials.

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement `BroadcastChannel` synchronization layer in `features/session-continuity/`
- [ ] Add event handlers for `WALLET_DISCONNECTED`, `NETWORK_CHANGED`, and `THEME_MUTATED`
- [ ] Render modal dialog when state conflict occurs requiring user confirmation
- [ ] Add unit tests mocking BroadcastChannel messages and verifying tab state alignment

## Files to look at
- `features/session-continuity/`
- `components/providers/ThemeModeProvider.tsx`
- `features/wallet/`

## Acceptance criteria
- Disconnecting wallet in Tab A instantly updates UI state in Tab B
- Conflicting tab actions trigger clear resolution prompts

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Build activity timeline PII redaction filter and CSV/JSON exporter
issues.body:
`features/activity-timeline/` displays user event logs, but does not sanitize sensitive data fields (e.g. IP addresses, private keys, auth headers) before display or export.

## Why this matters
Exporting or viewing unredacted timeline logs risks accidental exposure of sensitive user or network tokens.

## Tasks
- [ ] Add pattern-matching PII sanitizer in `features/activity-timeline/` redacting secret tokens, JWTs, and IP addresses
- [ ] Build log exporter allowing users to download sanitized activity logs in CSV and JSON formats
- [ ] Add search and filter controls by date range and event severity
- [ ] Add unit tests verifying PII scrubbing on sample log payloads

## Files to look at
- `features/activity-timeline/`
- `app/dashboard/`

## Acceptance criteria
- Sensitive key patterns and IP strings are replaced with `[REDACTED]` badges in UI and exports
- Exported CSV/JSON files contain valid, sanitized event timelines

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Implement differential privacy noise injection for maintainer analytics
issues.body:
`features/analytics/` and `lib/analytics.ts` collect aggregate usage metrics but lack privacy-preserving noise mechanisms to prevent individual user tracking from aggregated statistics.

## Why this matters
Applying differential privacy guarantees that aggregate telemetry cannot be reverse-engineered to identify specific user habits.

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement Laplace / Randomized Response noise algorithm in `features/analytics/`
- [ ] Apply privacy budget (`epsilon`) parameter controls to client-side metric reporting
- [ ] Add privacy audit log displaying active privacy protection settings
- [ ] Add unit tests verifying mathematical distribution of noise injection

## Files to look at
- `features/analytics/`
- `lib/analytics.ts`
- `features/analytics/__tests__/privacy.test.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Aggregate metric reports include mathematically bounded differential noise
- No raw individual activity traces are transmitted without privacy transformation

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Add strict Content Security Policy (CSP) headers and DOMPurify sanitizer rules
issues.body:
`components/security/` sanitizes input but Next.js configuration lacks strict Content Security Policy (CSP) HTTP headers restricting script sources, object embeds, and style injection.

## Why this matters
A robust CSP header mitigates Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection vulnerabilities across all application routes.

## Tasks
- [ ] Configure strict CSP headers in `next.config.js` (`script-src`, `style-src`, `connect-src`, `frame-ancestors`)
- [ ] Integrate DOMPurify in `components/security/SafeContent.tsx` for sanitizing rich user descriptions
- [ ] Add nonce generation for inline scripts required by Next.js and MUI Emotion
- [ ] Add unit tests for XSS payload stripping in `tests/__tests__/content-sanitizer.test.ts`

## Files to look at
- `next.config.js`
- `components/security/SafeContent.tsx`
- `lib/security/content-sanitizer.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- CSP headers pass security scanning checks without unsafe-inline script permissions
- Malicious script tags in user content are stripped prior to rendering

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Implement Server-Sent Events (SSE) progress streaming for batch CSV import

## Why this matters
Streaming import progress provides real-time feedback during large data ingestions and prevents HTTP request timeout errors.

- [ ] Add cancel button in import modal sending abort signal to terminate ongoing import jobs
- [ ] Add integration tests in `tests/__tests__/import-pipeline.test.ts` for SSE stream parsing

## Files to look at
- `app/api/import/route.ts`
- `lib/import/pipeline.ts`
- `docs/import-pipeline.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- Large CSV imports stream real-time progress percentages to the UI modal

issues.title: Trellis Frontend: Implement Zustand state persistence middleware and hydration mismatch protection
issues.body:
`store/searchStore.ts`, `store/referralStore.ts`, and `store/apiMetricsStore.ts` manage state with Zustand, but lack standardized `persist` middleware configuration and client hydration safety.

## Why this matters
Without proper hydration handling, loading persisted store state from local storage causes Next.js React hydration mismatch errors on page load.

## Tasks
- [ ] Configure `zustand/middleware` `persist` with custom storage serialisers across all stores
- [ ] Add `useHasHydrated` hook preventing SSR/CSR HTML mismatches when reading persisted store state
- [ ] Add store migration functions for handling state schema updates
- [ ] Add unit tests for store serialization and rehydration in `store/`

## Files to look at
- `store/searchStore.ts`
- `store/referralStore.ts`
- `store/apiMetricsStore.ts`
- `store/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- Zustand stores persist selected state across page reloads seamlessly
- Next.js pages load without React hydration mismatch warnings in the developer console
